title: HTML Attributes and Values
ques: Explain what **HTML attributes** are and how they modify element behavior. Provide an anchor link element with `href`, `target`, `rel`, and `title` attributes.

answer.content: Explore Documentation

explanation: Attributes appear inside opening tags as `name="value"` pairs. `href` specifies the destination URL, `target="_blank"` opens a new tab, and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` prevents tab-nabbing vulnerabilities.
